title: Orbit Board v1.3.9 — Complete Feature & Ergonomics Update
changelog: 🔤 2 New Custom Fonts: Agency FB (geometric modern sans with full lowercase) and Qurova (futuristic rounded typography with fixed numeral fallbacks)
🌌 Dynamic Background & Typing Effects: Added Constellation Web (cyber threads & Nothing Red nodes), calibrated Bubble Burst (20 micro-particles), Radar Wave, and Particle Burst
🎙️ Voice Typing Enhancements: System speech engine fallback, on-device offline recognition, microphone permission dialog guidance, and 'Mute Voice Typing Sound' toggle

🇧🇩 Key Alignment & Layout Ergonomics: Probhat 'র' popup re-engineered (ড় center, ্র right, র্ left), Jatiyo Classic & Modern Dari '।' shifted to Dot '.' position, and enhanced Bengali keytop hint labels
␣ Spacebar Customization: Spacebar swipe cursor navigation, spacebar language label display/pinning with smooth fadeout, and space deletion bug fixes
✨ 3 New Interactive Popups: Minimal wrap-content Language Switcher dialog (20dp Bauhaus card), In-App Auto-Update BottomSheet, and Remote Announcement BottomSheet
🎨 Brand New Theme Presets: Added Taiyaki Bakery (warm toasted kawaii biscuit preset), Chaos Theme, Radar Wave Theme, and tuned Matte Orbit dark palettes
⚡ 120Hz Zero-Allocation Loop: Ultra-responsive 120Hz display drawing loop with zero memory allocation / zero lag
🔒 100% Offline & Private: Zero network permissions, complete on-device keystroke privacy
